SELECT id, batch_code, material_type, specification, thickness, quantity, unit, unit_price, total_price, stock_status, is_oxidizable, storage_days, production_date, expiration_date, supplier, warehouse_location, remark, create_time, update_time FROM material_inventory WHERE deleted = 0
AND material_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.materialType}, '%')
AND specification LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.specification}, '%')
AND stock_status = #{query.stockStatus}
AND supplier LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.supplier}, '%')
AND batch_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.batchCode}, '%')
ORDER BY create_time DESC
